about.title: About the Celestial Storm set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Celestial Storm is a Sun & Moon expansion released on 3 August 2018. It has 183 cards: 168 in the main set and 15 secret rares. There are also 137 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 168 main set cards), the Master set (305 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 320 cards, adding the 15 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
